perche: Z-C21.11, finding N27. An envelope is a component for reference: CreateMassProperty of the assembly leaves it out. The Z-C21.3 probe of envelopes and BOM children (28/9/2026) measured it on two envelopes, one inserted with InsertEnvelope and one converted with CompConfigProperties6 (16000 mm3 of 26000), and zc2111/probe_alleggeriti (30/9/2026) again: part A plus envelope E weighed the volume of A only. Up to library 0.146.0 the check against the sum of the parts added E, so a right assembly was refused with a gap of 0.5. The library now leaves envelopes out of the sum as SOLIDWORKS leaves them out of the mass, and names them; the box keeps them and names them too. The bench makes the lid an envelope with CompConfigProperties6, as the probe of 28/9 («envelope», read back with IsEnvelope before the first step).
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: A right assembly refused because the sum of the parts counts an envelope that the mass of SOLIDWORKS leaves out; an envelope weighed as a part; an envelope dropped from the box; an answer that does not say an envelope was left out.
se_resta_verde_sulla_libreria_vecchia: It cannot: on 0.146.0 the assembly mass is 0.768 kg and the sum of the parts 1.0752 kg, the gap is far over the threshold and step 1 refuses, while it asks for the mass.
i_numeri: Base 120 x 80 x 10 (96000 mm3), lid 120 x 80 x 4 (38400 mm3) centred at y = 7, both AISI 304 (8000 kg/m3). The lid is the envelope: the mass is the base alone, 96000 x 8000 = 0.768 kg; the box holds both, 120 x 14 x 80.
